release_notes.en-US: Version 1.0.1 improves project transparency and release packaging. It adds the complete readable MIT-licensed source, reproducible build instructions, verified Chrome, Firefox, and Opera packages, and current Firefox compatibility declarations for Mozilla's built-in no-data setting. Detection behavior, permissions, and privacy behavior are unchanged.

version.approval_notes: Grandma Guard uses plain, readable JavaScript, HTML, CSS, JSON, and PNG files. It has no bundler, minifier, generated runtime code, third-party libraries, telemetry, remote code, or data collection. The repository release workflow reproduces the submitted package and runs all 25 detection regression cases.
